name: orbit-night-caps-verify-off
description: ORBIT-NIGHT-CAPS, the FLAG-OFF twin of orbit-night-caps-verify.json: the pre-fix render, with the baked-GI patch still on the section-cut faces and the reveal lift still constant. Same poses and same hours, so the pairs diff one variable. Run with SHOT_GPU=1 and SHOT_URL='http://localhost:5200/?ff=orbitNightCaps:off'.

steps.name: capture-init
steps.eval: (() => { window.__caps = { logs: [] }; const info = console.info.bind(console); const warn = console.warn.bind(console); console.info = (...a) => { const s = String(a[0]); if (s.includes('lightmaps:')) window.__caps.logs.push(s); info(...a) }; console.warn = (...a) => { const s = String(a[0]); if (s.includes('lightmaps:')) window.__caps.logs.push(s); warn(...a) } })()

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(20); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: pose-living
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 4.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()
